bullet_facts.fact: Michael and Stanley's relationship involved gossip about Stanley having an affair.
Stanley admitted to having an affair with Cynthia, who was also married.
Michael discussed Stanley's midlife crisis and rumors of him being at a club for young people.
Michael described Stanley as mean-spirited, saying he talks about people behind their backs.
Michael falsely claimed Stanley was planning to leave the office for another job.
Michael expressed concern about Stanley's relationship with his wife, Teri, and his affair with Cynthia.

supporting_quotes.quote: Michael: Well, it turns out that Teri was already suspicious, because she had caught Stanley and Cynthia a few months ago.
